sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 14

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 14:1
items.html: They are the aspect of Hesed and Gevura of the ten Sefirot of the head. And although in the Partzufim of AK the eyes are discerned as Hochma and Bina, nevertheless it was explained above, in Answer 12, that the HBD of the ten Sefirot of the NHY of Atik were divided into two aspects, MEM and LAMED, according to the division of Bina into its first three and its lower seven; and accordingly the ten Sefirot of the head were also divided. Hence the Hochma and Bina of the head were also divided into two aspects: the two ears are their first three, the aspect of MEM, and they are discerned as Hochma and Bina. And the two eyes are the aspect of the VAK within Hochma and Bina, the aspect of LAMED, and hence they are discerned as HGT. For since the first three of Hochma and Bina received the aspect of MEM, the eyes, which came out outside the aspect of the first three, became HGT. Hence the aspect of the eyes in the Partzufim of Atzilut was changed, so that they are not the aspect of Hochma and Bina as in AK; for this is due to the correction of the Tzelem that was renewed in the Partzufim of Atzilut, in which the HBD were divided into first three and lower seven, as explained. Hence there are here two aspects of HGT: the first is the aspect of LAMED, which is truly HBD, but through the correction of the MEM it came out of the first three and became HGT; and the second is the true HGT, which is the TZADIK of Tzelem.
